Senior Backend Engineer (also open at Staff level) on Close's backend platform team, building internal developer tooling and platform infrastructure for the company's CRM product. The work spans cloud development environments, automated code review and root-cause tooling, API paved roads, and guardrails for coding agents, serving four internal product teams rather than external customers. Primary stack is Python with a Flask-to-FastAPI migration in progress, alongside GraphQL, REST/OpenAPI, AWS, and Kubernetes, with some Go, Rust, and TypeScript in the mix.
